# eon_restore_account_region_aws_vpcs (Data Source)

Retrieves the VPCs available to Eon in a region of a restore account. Use this data source to pick a VPC before choosing subnets and security groups for `eon_restore_job`, for example as the `vpc_id` filter of `eon_restore_account_region_aws_security_groups`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: List VPCs available in a region of a restore account
data "eon_restore_account_region_aws_vpcs" "demo" {
  account_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  region     = "us-east-1"
}

# Example: Use the first VPC to narrow security groups
data "eon_restore_account_region_aws_security_groups" "first_vpc" {
  account_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  region     = "us-east-1"
  vpc_id     = data.eon_restore_account_region_aws_vpcs.demo.vpcs[0].id
}

output "vpc_ids" {
  description = "VPC IDs available in the region"
  value       = [for v in data.eon_restore_account_region_aws_vpcs.demo.vpcs : v.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the restore account.
- `region` (String) Region where the VPCs are located.

### Read-Only

- `vpcs` (Attributes List) List of VPCs available in the region. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpcs))

<a id="nestedatt--vpcs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpcs`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Cloud-provider-assigned ID of the VPC.
- `name` (String) Name of the VPC. Null if the VPC has no name.
